s1.why: Picked a, which says pipelining makes one instruction faster; pipelining only raises the total throughput, one instruction still takes the same time.
100 is not 103: the first instruction takes 4 cycles and each of the other 99 finishes one cycle later, 4 + 99 = 103. The learner seems to count one cycle per instruction.
It says instructions overlap, which is right, but it does not say that one instruction still takes the same time and only the total gets shorter.
